The updated `src/auth/token.py` adds `rotate_token_with_retry` which:

- Retries only transient `TimeoutError`-backed failures (via `should_retry_rotation`)
- Gives up after a configurable window defaulting to 30 seconds
- Lets permanent failures (e.g. `ValueError`) propagate immediately without retrying
- Leaves `rotate_token` and `should_retry_rotation` untouched for legacy-client compatibility
